chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 183: Li Huowang Refuses to Be Played
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang's paranoia pays off. When a rice divination entity offers a suspiciously easy fix for his missing Five Phases, he calls its bluff and draws his sword.
og_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 183: The Venerable is Told to Get Lost
og_description: Our protagonist decides the entity possessing the rice medium is full of it. He smashes the ritual, tells it to scram, and gets a side hustle as an escort guard.
twitter_title: Ch. 183: Li Huowang Calls BS on a Deity
twitter_description: The Zuowandao taught him well. Li Huowang is done being a passive question-answerer. He picks up a sword and picks a fight with a god.
